question: Which of the following chemicals is responsible for the yellow colour in urine?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Urobilin**__.

__
 
• **The Urobilin chemical is responsible for the yellow colour in urine.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• Urobilin is also known as **urochrome**.
 
• It is a type of carboxylic acid that causes the yellow colour in urine.
